propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root to allow both Jira adapters and root-core consumers to share it without violating the J7 sibling-adapter import seal
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would break the J7 seal forbidding datacenter-to-cloud adapter imports
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py cannot consume that layer
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption must document the permanent architectural reason for the root location rather than describing it as temporary relocation debt
the module's by-path load of adapters/jira/adf.py makes any destination other than the root or adapters/jira/ require laundering the AST contract gate
